items.title: Frank Adams Interview, 1959-01-20
items.q: When I was a little boy, it was King Boland... We used to call him King Boland, and his name was Buddy Boland at that time.

ctx.x: Now, did your folks, your father play any instrument? Never did. Your mother, was she a singer or anything? No, never was. What was the first music you remember hearing when you were a little boy? Can you remember any? When I was a little boy, it was King Boland.
King Boland. What kind of a band did he have? Well, King Boland used to play a cornet, I think it was. Yeah. Yeah, he used to play a cornet. Called him King Boland.
Remember how big a band he had? Was it a big band, the little women?
